newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe industrials rise in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe industrials rise in active trade.

text.p: Extending their bull run, Zimbabwe industrial shares finished Wednesday stronger in active trade with some heavyweight stocks giving a robust performance.

"It was another busy day and some big shares like Meikles and Delta enjoyed good trade. The market is still on its way up and while they may not be huge gains, things are looking good," one dealer said.
Underlying fundamentals remained strong and dealers said it was unlikely the market would lose its upward momentum for some time yet, particularly with new issues likely to get positive receptions.
"Except for maybe one or two dips like yesterday's, there is no reason why this market cannot keep climbing at least until the middle of next week, maybe a while longer," one dealer said.
The 57-share industrial index added 60.77 points to 10,724.34 points with Delta putting on 50 cents to 1,750 cents and Meikles rising 200 cents to 2,800 cents.
But Barclays lost 100 cents to 3,700 cents, BAT shed 200 cents to 2,100 cents and TSL cut 20 cents to 680 cents.
Mining shares also enjoyed an active day, but the index dipped 6.16 points to 882.89 points, mainly on a 700 cent fall in Falcon to 600 cents following its profit warning on Tuesday.
Ashanti, Bindura and Wankie all traded unchanged. Falgold put on five cents to 65 cents.
